Availability is not knowledge, but it is often sold as knowledge. The observatory keeps a lens in the vision chamber because we refuse to pretend that seeing is free.","To train a model to recognize a face is to decide that faces are a public weather. Some of them are. A stop sign is. A tumor in a scan, with consent, can be. A person at a protest is not a stop sign. The instrument does not know the difference. The people who point it must.","There is a quieter cost. Even the images we call synthetic are distilled from a billion glances that were not asked for. The street that does not exist is stitched from streets that did. The model is a compress of other people’s windows.","We can still look. Looking is how you catch a fracture in a plate, a bias in a dataset, a medical signal that would have waited a year. The ethic is not abstinence. It is the old scientific one, restated for a new instrument: know what the lens is doing to the room, and who is in the room.","At night, in the dome, the Core becomes a pupil. That is not an accident of design. We wanted the site itself to feel watched — and then to hand the watching back to you. You may close the tab.
